title: Selume Plan Probe
heading: Connect your diary to ChatGPT
intro: Verify sign-in, plan permission and one complete response on this phone. This separate test app does not access your diary.
loginHint: Sign in and authorize on the official page within 15 minutes. When the browser finishes, return to this app manually.
callbackMessage: Authorization callback received. Return to Selume Plan Probe to see the verification result.
pasteCallbackHint: If the browser reaches 127.0.0.1 but cannot open the page, copy the complete address and paste it here. Complete this within 15 minutes of starting this sign-in.
pasteCallbackInstructions: Paste only the complete http://127.0.0.1:port/auth/callback?... address returned for this sign-in. It contains one-time authorization information. Handle it only in this app and do not send it to anyone.
callbackInputError: The address is incomplete or does not match this sign-in. Copy the complete browser return address, not the OpenAI sign-in page or an old authorization address.
callbackExpiredError: This sign-in has ended or expired. Close this dialog and start a new sign-in.
permissionOff: Plan permission was not granted. Authorize again to continue.
modelHint: Choose an available model. Each test uses your ChatGPT plan or available credits.
testRunning: Testing. Waiting for a complete response…
testFailed: Test failed. A complete response was not confirmed
testPrompt: Test prompt: Reply with exactly OK.
refreshHint: This refreshes your credentials and sends another message to verify session renewal.
replyPending: Waiting for a test. A response passes only after the server confirms completion.
usageHint: Check this app's permission and limits in ChatGPT usage settings. One short reply may not visibly change the usage percentage.
restartHint: After a completed response, close and reopen this app and send another test message to check session restoration.
genericError: Check the diagnostic code and retry the current step.
htmlResponseError: The endpoint returned a web page instead of a model response stream. This may come from the service or a network intermediary. Copy diagnostics and keep the proxy settings that provide connectivity.
jsonResponseError: The endpoint returned JSON instead of the expected response stream. The test did not pass. Copy diagnostics for further investigation.
responseFormatError: The response type was unexpected, so model completion could not be verified. Copy diagnostics for further investigation.
emptyResponseError: The endpoint returned HTTP 200 with an empty body. No model response was received. Copy diagnostics and keep the proxy settings that provide connectivity.
incompleteResponseError: A valid complete response was not received. Partial text does not confirm success. Copy diagnostics for further investigation.
networkError: Could not connect. Check your network and retry. Temporary network failures do not remove saved credentials.
permissionError: ChatGPT plan usage is not authorized or is unavailable for this account or workspace.
limitError: A plan or app usage limit was reached. Review ChatGPT usage settings.
loginError: Sign-in validation failed. Please sign in again.
timeoutError: The operation timed out. Please start this step again.
authorizationTimeoutError: The browser authorization result did not arrive before the deadline, so this sign-in has ended. Close the old authorization page and select Continue with ChatGPT again. Refreshing the old 127.0.0.1 page cannot resume it.
browserLaunchTimeoutError: Opening the browser timed out. Check that a browser is available on this phone, then select Continue with ChatGPT again.
revocationError: Local credentials were cleared, but remote revocation was not confirmed. Disconnect this app in ChatGPT settings.

phases(map).waiting_browser: Complete authorization in the browser, then return here
phases(map).pending_authorization: Unfinished sign-in restored. Paste the browser result to continue

steps(map).restored: Saved sign-in restored from secure storage
